gate.title: Twenty lanterns, waiting for midnight
gate.openSub: All twenty of them. Look who’s twenty.

lines: I made you something.
It got slightly out of hand.
Don’t skip anything. I’ll know.

prologue.title: Once Upon a {name}
lines: Once upon a time — 3 January 2007, to be precise —
the sun got careless and spilled a drop of light.
It fell quietly through the dark. Nobody noticed.
Where it landed, something golden bloomed.
By morning, everyone noticed.

tower.title: A Tower Full of You
lines: Imagine a tower, a lot of free time, and far too much paint.
Some people would paint the sky. Or flowers. Or the sea.
I’d run out of wall long before I ran out of you.
tower.windowLine: Wait. Something golden just drifted past the window. Follow it.

memories.text: It started at a college event. That’s where we met.
After that, we talked every day.
College to home, and back again. By bus. By train.
And you’d tell me about your day.

hair.title: The Golden Thread
lines: Some people keep their memories in a shoebox.
Ours needed something longer. About the length of your hair.
Every memory is another strand. Every year adds another.
hair.heroHairLine: The original. The golden thread is just doing an impression.
hair.endLine: Every moment connects to the next. And we’re nowhere near done.

names.title: A Legend of Many Names
names.subject: Subject: {name} (extremely rare)
documentary: Here, in her natural habitat, we observe the rare {name}.
Confirmed sightings so far: {photoCount} photographs. We have the evidence.
Approach slowly, ideally with cake. Never touch the hair.
Do not startle her. She has access to a frying pan.
Remarkably, she answers to more than one name. The second one is… a lot.

items.name: Deepu
items.sub: Twenty of them, as of tonight. She’s going to need a bigger sky.

items.name: Kuchu Puchu
items.line: The Final Form. Witnessed by very few.

names.scratch: okay. we tried. this one is too cute for the scary font.
names.finale: Two names. One legend. Absolutely impossible to recast.

dance.title: Somewhere Between Chaos and Magic
lines: Every good festival is about sixty percent chaos.
The other forty percent is magic. Same as every good friendship.
Look up. The sky’s starting to notice.

lanterns.title: The Night of Lanterns
lines: One lantern is just a little light.
A hundred is a celebration.
Thousands? That’s the sky making a point.
And tonight, the point is you.
lanterns.tapHint: Tap the sky to send up a lantern of your own
lanterns.photoHint: Some of these lanterns are carrying memories. Tap one.
lanterns.after: All this light, and it’s still not the brightest thing in this film.
lanterns.secret: You found the pink one. It was looking for you.

letter.title: A Letter You Were Supposed to Read
letter.fasterHint: Reading faster than I can write? Tap to skip ahead.
body: Okay. Before you say anything: yes, I made you an entire film instead of just saying this to your face. No, I will not be taking questions. Please put the frying pan down.
We met at a college event. After that, we talked every day. That’s the whole origin story: no dramatic music, no magic lanterns. Just a conversation that kept going.
Then there were the journeys, college to home and back again, by bus and by train. If you look closely, they’re in this film too: the windows, the light, the long way home.
And you’d tell me about your day. I liked hearing it. I still do.
And yes, I’m still going to tease you about {tease}. Forever. Some traditions are sacred.
If I had to pick one moment, though, it’s this one: {neverForget}
The thing I admire most about you? {admire}
You love Tangled, so I borrowed a little of its magic: the lanterns, the tower, a golden thread about as long as your hair. Every memory is another strand. Tonight, all of them lead to twenty.
Here’s what I want for your twenties: good days that run late, hair that keeps growing and worries that don’t, and more journeys, the kind worth telling me about.
And if you only remember one line from this whole film, make it this one: {wantHerToKnow}
Happy 20th birthday, Kuchu Puchu. Thank you for being my best friend. (You’re allowed to screenshot that part.) Now go back to the film. There’s cake.
letter.signoff: Stuck with me forever. No refunds,

cake.title: Twenty Candles
lines: Okay… one last thing.
Make a wish, {name}.
But first…
Twenty candles.
cake.blowHint: Make a wish. Then tap the mic and blow. All twenty. No pressure.
cake.afterBlow: Show-off. Whatever you wished for, I’m already on its side.
cake.cutHint: Now swipe across the cake to cut it
cake.afterCut: First slice is yours. The last one is… under negotiation.
cake.wish: I snuck in a wish too: that you get yours, plus whatever you forgot to ask for.

constellation.title: Every Little Piece of You
lines: On their own, they’re just moments.
Connect them, and look what they were making all along.
constellation.handwritten: That’s my best friend, by the way.

birthday.title: The Last Lantern
lanterns: Every one of those days deserved a lantern.
birthday.strands: Tonight, all those strands lead to 20.
birthday.name: {name}
loved: In case you ever forget, on some bad day:
you are loved. Not politely. Properly.
The kind that would build you a whole sky. And did.
birthday.closing: I’m really glad you were born. That’s the whole film.

hug.title: One Last Thing
lines: Okay, final step.
Send me a hug.
hug.holdLonger: Longer. It’s a hug, not a high five.
done: Hug received. Excellent technique. Very strong.
Now go send me the real one.
hug.message: I watched the whole thing. You’re ridiculous. Come here. Hug. Now. 🫂

roles: {photoCount} photographs, one golden thread, and a lot of memories
one shy chameleon · twenty candles · a sky full of lanterns
postCredits: Wait. Where did the last slice go?
The chameleon is now exactly the colour of frosting.
It says happy birthday. With its mouth full.
credits.extrasSub: Everything that didn’t fit, and everything still to come.
